hooks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $guardDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'dotfiles/codex/mise/scripts'; Set-Location $guardDir; $pythonPath = $null; foreach ($candidateName in @('python3', 'python')) { $candidate = Get-Command $candidateName -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $candidate) { continue }; try { & $candidate.Source -I -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else 1)' *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $pythonPath = $candidate.Source; break } } catch { continue } }; if ($null -eq $pythonPath) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Codex prompt blocked: Python 3.11+ is unavailable in Codex PATH.'); exit 2 }; & $pythonPath -I (Join-Path $guardDir 'block_downloads.py'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Codex prompt blocked: could not start the Downloads guard.') }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Codex prompt blocked: Downloads guard returned non-zero status.'); exit 2
